objects.description: [WarzoneRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0670) has the capability to install a live and offline keylogger, including through the use of the `GetAsyncKeyState` Windows API.(Citation: Check Point Warzone Feb 2020)(Citation: Uptycs Warzone UAC Bypass November 2020)
